status_note: Cue sheet by S11. Nothing generated here. Library cues come from content/series1/sound/library.json (generated once by the separate runner and shared by both language cuts). The only possible one-off is a contingency, generated only if Kiran's recorded in-breath fails voice review.
timebase: Anchored to beat ids, line ids and the silences in each beat, not to seconds. No shots.json exists yet, and under D-014 rule 6 and D-0M2 shots follow the measured voice, so S13 turns these anchors into times from each language's own timeline. One cue sheet serves both the Hindi and English cuts.

anchor_vocabulary.head: start of the beat
anchor_vocabulary.silence_before / silence_after: the beat's silent_seconds stretch on the side the script gives
anchor_vocabulary.after:lNN / under:lNN / before:lNN: relative to the measured speech of that line

contingency_cues.trigger: Kiran's recorded in-breath (owned by the voice take, library episode_specific_not_in_library) fails voice review: missing, voices a word, or reads as a gasp. Plan 7.8 and D-011: one take.
contingency_cues.prompt: A young woman's single quiet in-breath through parted lips, about to speak but not speaking, close and dry in a silent room. One soft breath in, no exhale, no voice, no word.

mix.loudness_target: -14 LUFS integrated, -1 dBTP, tolerance +/-0.5 LU (D-0M4). Each language cut mastered separately from its own timeline.
music_in_out: b1 to b3: no music. Bed, breath, the clinks and the tray only.
In: mus_bed_drone at the head of b4, barely audible.
b9 (lane): drone lifts about 2 dB; drops back at the cut to b10.
b10 head: 2 s crossfade from mus_bed_drone into mus_tension_pulse as the phone lights.

b10 l29 and b13 l30: drone/pulse and both ambiences ducked right down (pulse about -12 dB from its level, beds about -6 dB) so the locked question 'दामाद जी ने दूध पी लिया, बेटा?' and its repeat are fully intelligible.
b12: pulse at its low level over the lane bed (no line).
Out: on Kiran's in-breath in b13, everything (music, bedroom bed) cuts to silence with a 10 ms fade; the breath sits alone, then the question card in silence. No sting.
ducking: All dialogue: music ducks about 8 dB under speech, beds about 4 dB, with 150 ms attack and 400 ms release.
b9 l23 to l27 (Mausi on Billu's phone): lane bed -6 dB extra; keep all three outcomes in l24 and l25 above it.
b10 l28: sfx_zip_pocket stays at least 12 dB under Mausi.
b10 l29, b13 l30: the deep duck in music_in_out.
filters: b9 l23, l24, l25, l27 (Mausi through Billu's phone in the lane): band-pass about 300-3400 Hz, light saturation, mono, dry; wide enough that every consonant survives; fully voiced, never whispered. Processing on the voice take, not a cue.

b10 l28, l29 and b13 l30 (Mausi on speaker in the room): lighter phone colour, about 200-5000 Hz band-pass with light saturation plus a short small-room reflection so she sits on the sheet, not in the ear. Still fully voiced.
No fan anywhere in this episode.
mix.silences: Every beat silence carries only the bed and the effect placed in it; S13 must not fill silences with music in b1 to b3.
mix.timing: Point effects are placed against the measured voice and edited shot lengths (D-014 rule 6, D-0M2); the anchors above are relative to lines, so they hold if lines run long.

fallback: If a music cue is missing after retries (plan 7.8): drop mus_tension_pulse and run mus_bed_drone alone from b4 to the in-breath; if both are missing, raise amb_bedroom_night 3 dB from b4 and log it in docs/morning-report.md. If any library effect is missing, the beat plays on its bed alone; none is a locked story beat except the b2 clinks, which fall back to a slice of sfx_glass_bangles_chink.
